players.product: network-on-chip (NoC) interconnect IP for AI SoCs

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q Q2 2026 revenue by product line: licensing, support and maintenance $20,824 thousand (+38% from $15,088 thousand), driven by new customers, new license arrangements with existing customers and hardware security verification products from the Cycuity acquisition; variable royalties $2,103 thousand (+50% from $1,402 thousand), from higher product sales by existing customers and new customers; professional services and other $1,207 thousand (from $12 thousand), primarily hardware security verification services under contract with the U.S. government, a significant portion delivered by third-party subcontractors acquired with Cycuity. Six-month revenue was $47,070 thousand (+42%).
